result.brief: 提出地图-语言-轨迹分层系统，用视觉语言模型逐条下发原子指令，由街景数据训练的轨迹预测器在图像中绘制路径，供强化学习策略跟踪，实现城市长距离具身导航。
result.reason: Hierarchical embodied navigation system with a learned image-space trace predictor from street-level images; main contribution is robot policy/planning, matching the secondary world-model applications direction.
